name: Tokitou Touko
source:
An individual under Tatebayashi's command who possesses supernatural powers. She can control spirits with her whip.  
A woman with a kind, dignified personality and strong will. She became a soldier for a certain purpose.
She mainly provides rear support.

"I can put it more simply for you. I'm telling you to bring it on!" — Tokitou Touko.
"Tatebayashi-sama. I'll take my leave now." — Tokitou Touko.
